operating_notes.text: FY26 standalone capex of ₹175.83 Cr was almost equal to operating cash flow of ₹172.88 Cr, with borrowings rising to ₹187.59 Cr including current maturities.
Allowance for credit loss on trade receivables rose to ₹6.80 Cr in FY26 from ₹3.23 Cr in FY25.
Related-party loans to RM Employee Benefit Trust stood at ₹4.86 Cr at 7.15–10% interest, with a further ₹5 Cr sanctioned but not disbursed to Liber Designs Private Limited.
